name: changelog-broadcaster
label: Changelog Broadcaster
desc: A weekly loop that distills your merged PRs into a changelog entry and social post drafts, held for your review.
description: Set up a weekly loop that turns this project's shipped work into a changelog and announcement drafts. Before creating it, verify this machine can see the week's merged PRs and commits - gh or the git log - run one listing as a smoke test, and confirm with me which changes are worth announcing (user-facing features and fixes, not internal churn) and the voice and channels to draft for; never create a blind loop. Every Monday around 9am my local time, review what merged since the previous run - the loop keeps track of where the last one ended - distill it into one clear changelog entry grouped by feature, fix, and improvement in plain user-facing language rather than raw commit messages, and draft short social posts from it for the channels we agreed. Everything is a draft held for my review - never auto-post anywhere; drafting for approval is the whole point of this loop. Write the changelog entry and the post drafts as dated markdown with front matter `type: report`, a `title`, and `date` so they ride the calendar, and report the count of items shipped that week as a metric; a quiet week with nothing user-facing is a clean stop. Set up the loop's dashboard at creation: a calendar of the entries plus an embed of the newest one.
